{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient
sample_seq_stats = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts()
print("\nMax sample_seq per patient:")
print(sample_seq_stats)

# Drop duplicate patient_id rows, keeping the one with highest sample_seq
# This is critical — the data says the highest sample_seq supersedes earlier rows
data_clean = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify that patient_id is now unique
print("\nAfter cleaning, patient_id unique?", data_clean['patient_id'].is_unique)

# Show the new shape
print("\nNew data shape:", data_clean.shape)"}
